assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks.
Given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93247.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
